items.title: Revamp Scheduled-Task Templates in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new design for the scheduled-task template gallery along with a five-step onboarding wizard. Key features include defining instantiation rules, server-owned template snapshots, and runtime variables, as well as outlining Phase 2 referral campaigns. The implementation is organized into dependency-ordered PRs for better management.

items.title: Enhance Kimi Code Integration Guide in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive Kimi Code integration guide, detailing CLI installation, Ace Data Cloud configuration, and usage instructions. Additionally, a new migration has been added to register the guide alongside existing resources, and a CDN-hosted favicon has been included. All changes have been verified with successful tests and live API checks.

items.title: Revamped Revenue Paths for Ace Data Cloud in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update restructures the revenue model from three paths to two distinct business models: promoting Ace Data Cloud and operating a white-label platform. Key changes include the separation of the white-label Studio and API Platform, along with the introduction of new promotional tutorials and operational documentation. The API delivery methods have been streamlined, enhancing clarity and usability for developers and users alike.

items.title: Streamline Auto-Recharge Page by Removing Migration Notice in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the outdated payment migration warning from the auto-recharge page, enhancing user experience. Additionally, unused translations across all locales have been eliminated, ensuring cleaner code and improved maintainability. These changes contribute to a more seamless interaction for users managing their auto-recharge settings.

items.title: Enhance TikTok Confirmation Branding in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update replaces the simulated music-note badge with the official TikTok brand glyph and localizes the TikTok confirmation title, summary, and action label based on the active Studio locale. Translations have been added across all supported locales, ensuring a consistent user experience. Comprehensive regression tests confirm that all changes are functioning as expected.

items.title: Streamline Usage History to API Only in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the Usage History page by removing the Type filter, ensuring it only displays API services. Additionally, it ignores the `type=Proxy` query parameter from old links to prevent access to the Proxy view. The API dropdown now exclusively shows interfaces belonging to the Api service type.

items.title: Enhance Transcript Recovery for Unsigned Thinking in Coding Bridge 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces a robust mechanism to detect and safely resume unsigned thinking transcripts in the Agent SDK. Key changes include the creation of a deterministic recovery fork that removes only invalid thinking blocks while preserving essential data. Comprehensive testing confirms that the system now handles various edge cases effectively, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Enhance Claude Alias Thinking Support in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update restores support for official Anthropic thinking shapes for configured Claude aliases, allowing requests to be routed through Responses reasoning. Key changes include handling enabled and adaptive thinking requests while ensuring fail-safe mechanisms for unknown shapes. The modifications enhance the functionality and reliability of the GitHub proxy for Claude models.

items.title: Enhance GitHub Proxy for Mainstream Parity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical gaps identified in the GitHub proxy by implementing fixes and adding regression coverage. Key improvements include normalization of token usage, enhanced parsing of Tornado SSE streams, and robust handling of endpoint mismatches. The changes ensure better compliance with mainstream models and improve overall system reliability.

items.title: Enhance Lossless Protocol Conversion in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This PR introduces a controlled native codec for models supporting the client protocol, ensuring the preservation of unknown extensions and metadata. It also implements a feature-aware cross-protocol planner that enforces lossless representations and fails on unsupported fields. Comprehensive validation has been performed, confirming the robustness of the new features and error handling mechanisms.

items.title: Enhance Usage Ledger for Dimensional Tracking in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a normalized dimensional usage ledger that consolidates Chat, Responses, and Messages usage. Key changes include separating input dimensions for uncached, cache-read, and cache-write, while maintaining authoritative billing totals. Additionally, fixes for cache double-counting ensure accurate client-visible usage metrics.

items.title: Enhance Streaming Terminal Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of streaming terminal states by tracking upstream terminal states and preserving the `response.incomplete` status. It ensures that protocol-native stream failures are emitted for various client types and that failed streams are closed cleanly. The changes enhance the robustness of the streaming functionality and have been validated with comprehensive test coverage.

items.title: Enhance Protocol Header Management in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enforces strict boundaries for protocol headers in the GitHub proxy. It allows only specific semantic request headers while stripping sensitive information like authorization and cookies. Additionally, it ensures that only relevant response headers are returned, improving security and compliance.

items.title: Freeze request routing snapshots for stable model plans in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces immutable request-scoped snapshots capturing model capabilities and routing plans, ensuring consistency per request. It versions successful catalog refreshes and includes these versions in structured logs. Debug headers exposing routing details are now available only when explicitly requested, keeping default responses clean. Comprehensive tests validate the new snapshot behavior and debug header functionality.

items.title: Enhance Proxy Security with Fail Closed on Unsupported States in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a fail-closed mechanism for unsupported stateful features in the GitHub proxy. Key changes include rejecting specific response and message fields before any catalog or model requests, ensuring that only valid stateless values are accepted. The implementation enhances the reliability of the proxy by preventing incorrect state handling across replicas and restarts.

items.title: Enhance Request Contracts for Stability in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update pins the audited OpenAI and Anthropic contract revisions in a committed manifest, ensuring deterministic generation of runtime request contracts without external dependencies. Key changes include the removal of optional Responses `input`, the requirement of `model` across all protocols, and the acceptance of specific cache pre-warm requests. Validation tests confirm that all changes are functioning as intended.

items.title: Enhance Branding with Dynamic Site Copy in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update integrates dynamic site-specific titles and descriptions into the hero sections of the home and intro pages. Previously, fixed marketing strings were displayed, which did not reflect the actual branding of the site. Now, the site title and description are used as the primary content, with fallback options for unconfigured sites.

items.title: Enhance TikTok Publish Validation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces validation for TikTok publish confirmations by exposing necessary creator and media fields in the action-confirmation tool schema. It ensures that malformed TikTok confirmations are rejected before conversation pauses, while maintaining compatibility with generic confirmations. Comprehensive tests have been conducted, achieving full pass rates across targeted and full worker test suites.

items.title: Enhance TikTok Publish Confirmation in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update redesigns the TikTok publish confirmation into a responsive media-and-settings review screen. Key improvements include media loading/error fallbacks, explicit validation reasons, and localized support across all languages. Additionally, incomplete creator-info payloads are now blocked to enhance user experience.

items.title: Enhance Debugger Reclamation Process in Frontend Web 🤖
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the Chrome MV3 worker fails to reclaim debugger attachments after a restart. The fix ensures that if a tab is already attached, it will be reclaimed without unnecessary detachment, improving the stability of the debugging process. Additionally, the code now filters out hidden duplicate controls, enhancing user interaction on the Xiaohongshu creator page.

items.title: Align CLI with Latest OpenAPI Updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The `seedream` and `suno` CLIs have been updated to reflect the latest documentation sync from PlatformBackend. Key changes include adjustments to command handlers, request option mappings, and endpoint path bindings to ensure consistency with the current OpenAPI specifications. These updates maintain existing command patterns while incorporating new requirements, ensuring a seamless user experience.

items.title: Sync Seedream and Suno MCPs with Latest Docs OpenAPI Updates in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the MCP implementations for Seedream and Suno with the latest changes in the Docs OpenAPI. Key adjustments include updated model/provider enums, request parameter handling, and response shaping to ensure compatibility with the current platform APIs. The changes maintain existing behavior while introducing new options as specified in the documentation.

items.title: Enhance CLI to Use Negative Tags in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the CLI to send the `negative_tags` field instead of `style_negative` for both generate and custom commands. The existing `--negative-style` flag remains intact, ensuring backward compatibility. All related tests have passed successfully, confirming the changes are robust and ready for deployment.

items.title: Enhance Suno SDK with Negative Tags Support in S D K 🎉
items.summary: This update regenerates the Python, TypeScript, and Go Suno provider clients to incorporate `negative_tags` in the public option names and outbound JSON. All SDKs have passed validation tests, ensuring functionality remains intact. The changes align the generated source with the stored Suno specification, paving the way for improved user experience.

items.title: Enhance Suno with Negative Tags in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces the ability to send excluded styles through the canonical `negative_tags` field in Suno. The legacy `style_negative` field is still supported for historical task reuse, ensuring a smooth transition. Key components in the configuration and task preview have been updated to reflect these changes.

items.title: Standardize negative_tags parameter in A P Is 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces the `negative_tags` parameter to the public Suno excluded-style request field, replacing the previous `style_negative` alias. This change ensures compatibility while enhancing clarity for users. The update is additive and non-billing, allowing old clients to function without interruption during the rollout.

items.title: Standardize negative_tags in Skills 🎶
items.summary: This update standardizes the public Suno excluded-style request field to `negative_tags`, replacing the previous `style_negative` alias for better clarity and consistency. The change is additive and non-billing, ensuring that old clients will continue to function during the rollout. This modification enhances the music skill's ability to avoid specific styles or genres effectively.

items.title: Enhance Suno Plugin with Negative Tags in Dify 🎉
items.summary: This update standardizes the Suno plugin by exposing the `negative_tags` field, replacing the previous `style_negative` alias. The changes ensure compatibility while enhancing functionality for users. The rollout is additive and non-billing, allowing old clients to continue operating seamlessly.

items.title: Enhance MCP Tools with Negative Tags in M C Ps 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces the `negative_tags` feature in the Suno MCP tool schema and payload, aligning with the canonical API contract. Key modifications include updates to the audio tools and tests to ensure proper functionality of the new parameter. The changes enhance the customization options for audio generation, allowing users to exclude specific styles more effectively.

items.title: Update Suno Negative Tags Field in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `negative_tags` field as the primary method for excluding styles in Suno, replacing the deprecated `style_negative` alias. The change ensures that runtime workers prioritize `negative_tags`, enhancing compatibility across various services. Validation confirms the successful integration of this new field into the public schema.

items.title: Standardize Negative Tags in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the public Suno excluded-style request field to `negative_tags`, ensuring consistency across the platform. The legacy `style_negative` will remain as a compatibility alias but will not take precedence. All affected TypeScript workers have been validated and compile successfully, maintaining backward compatibility for existing clients.

items.title: Streamline Logo Rendering from Site Config in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update enhances the Logo component by ensuring it directly uses the Site's logo configuration, eliminating hostname-based branding decisions. The new logic applies uniformly across all domains, allowing for dynamic rendering of logos while maintaining fallback options. Comprehensive testing confirms that all branding scenarios are functioning correctly.

items.title: Enhance Solana Signing Process in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the Solana signing process by fetching the recent blockhash through the PlatformBackend proxy, eliminating the need for direct public RPC calls. It also builds the official v2 payment envelope locally, which helps avoid 403 errors during wallet signing. These changes enhance the reliability and security of the payment process.

items.title: Revamp Presentation Header and Card Layout in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: The `/intro` page now features a streamlined presentation header with a single centered logo, removing unnecessary navigation elements. Additionally, product rows are now balanced across devices, ensuring a cleaner layout with up to five columns on desktop. Comprehensive testing confirms all changes are functioning as intended, enhancing user experience.

items.title: Ensure Seedream Sync with Updated Docs in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the Seedream MCP aligns with the latest OpenAPI specifications. Key changes include the removal of deprecated models and parameters, ensuring that supported Seedream models and endpoint paths are consistent with the upstream spec. No source or test changes were necessary for this alignment.

items.title: Streamline Seedream Plugin Options in Dify 🎉
items.summary: This update removes the unavailable Seedream 3.0 T2I and SeedEdit 3.0 options from the generate/edit tool forms. It introduces Seedream 5.0 Pro and 5.0 Lite to enhance functionality. Additionally, unsupported handling of `seed` and `guidance_scale` has been eliminated, ensuring smoother image generation processes.

items.title: Streamline Seedream Image Skills in Skills 🎨
items.summary: This update removes the unavailable Seedream 3.0 T2I and SeedEdit 3.0 options from the canonical Seedream image skill. It also updates the image editing examples to utilize Seedream 5.0 Lite and eliminates unsupported parameters, ensuring clarity in model-specific sizes. These changes enhance the user experience by focusing on currently supported features.

items.title: Streamline Seedream Documentation by Removing Outdated Models in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update removes references to the unavailable Seedream 3.0 models from the API documentation, including the README and integration guide. The image editing examples have been updated to utilize the Seedream 5.0 Lite model and the current image array field. Additionally, the Coze schema has been aligned with the latest versions, enhancing clarity and usability.

items.title: Streamline CLI by Removing Unavailable Models in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unavailable Seedream 3.0 T2I and SeedEdit 3.0 models from the CLI model list. The README and model help documentation have been updated accordingly, and regression tests have been added to ensure retired models remain excluded. This change enhances the clarity and usability of the CLI for users.

items.title: Streamline Seedream Tool Options in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unavailable Seedream 3.0 T2I and SeedEdit 3.0 options from public model literals, ensuring users have access only to supported models. The default image editing has been set to Seedream 5.0 Lite, and guidance for model editing and resolution capabilities has been corrected across various documentation. These changes enhance clarity and usability for users relying on the Seedream tools.

items.title: Streamline Seedream Options in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unavailable Seedream 3.0 models from the Studio model picker and migrates any persisted configurations to supported defaults. Incompatible values are cleared during migration, and dead capability branches have been eliminated with added regression tests. The changes ensure a smoother user experience by focusing on currently supported models.

items.title: Retire Seedream 3.0 Models in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the Seedream 3.0 T2I and SeedEdit 3.0 models from the OpenAPI enum and customer-facing documentation. Additionally, it updates service pricing to exclude these retired models while maintaining hidden billing rules for historical settlements. The changes also correct model size guidance and image-editing examples to reflect current supported models.

items.title: Retire outdated Seedream 3.0 models in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unavailable Seedream 3.0 T2I and SeedEdit model IDs from the worker allowlist, ensuring that requests for these retired models are rejected with an HTTP 400 error. The existing Seedream 5.0 Pro, 5.0 Lite, 4.5, and 4.0 paths remain unchanged, maintaining service stability. This change is part of a coordinated withdrawal of Seedream v3 models to enhance overall performance.

items.title: Revamped Campaign Copy and Product Cards in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update enhances the introductory page with a cohesive campaign voice, replacing admin-style headings with engaging, user-friendly titles. Each product card now features its canonical brand logo, improving recognition and consistency across the platform. The changes aim to create a more inviting experience for users while maintaining accurate capability listings.

items.title: Fix heartbeat collision disconnects in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where simultaneous heartbeat signals caused the relay to erroneously close healthy connections. The fix implements a rate limit specifically for unsolicited client heartbeats while allowing immediate ACKs from the relay, ensuring stable connections. Comprehensive tests confirm that the changes prevent the `heartbeat_rate_exceeded` error and maintain connection integrity.

items.title: Fix config persistence to prevent outdated IP issues in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes `config` from the persisted state in Vuex to avoid issues with outdated IP addresses affecting region detection. Users switching networks or using VPNs will no longer face incorrect menu and payment option visibility. Key states like user, token, and currency remain intact while ensuring a smoother experience.

items.title: Complete Protocol Parity Plan for GitHub Proxy in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive audit of the Chat Completions, Responses, and Messages protocols under the GitHub Proxy. Key changes include the registration of the plan in the authoritative index and the definition of a lossless protocol AST along with various implementation policies. The implementation will proceed as stacked PRs, ensuring thorough review before merging.

items.title: Enhance Studio Capability Flags in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update ensures that the `/intro` page correctly reflects the enabled capabilities for all sites, including `studio.acedata.cloud`. Key changes include improved loading states, accurate filtering of model and product cards, and the use of appropriate screenshots based on enabled features. The misleading 'models' statistic has been replaced with 'available products' for clarity.

items.title: Fix in-cluster client initialization for Helm deployment in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the in-cluster client was not explicitly initialized, causing connection errors during Helm operations. A new method, `get_k8s_networking_client()`, ensures that the Networking client is built only after the necessary configurations are loaded. The changes have been validated with 70 tests passing and a successful dry run on the discord-bot Ingress.

items.title: Final Implementation of Soft Cutoff Adjustments in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the deployment issues caused by the AKS admission webhook, which prevented multiple Ingress entries with the same host/path. Key changes include adding a 302 redirect for all tenant Ingress to the purchase page, ensuring platform availability during billing, and implementing a strategy for handling RBAC failures. The adjustments align with user expectations for site-wide interception during payment issues.

items.title: Fix Ingress Design Flaw for AKS Deployment in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue with the Ingress configuration that caused deployment failures in AKS due to duplicate host/path entries. The solution simplifies the design by implementing a 302 redirect to the renewal page, ensuring compliance with user requirements for site-wide blocking. Additionally, it resolves several gaps in the deployment process, enhancing overall stability and security.

items.title: Fix payment method handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where orders without a payment method were incorrectly categorized as 'Unknown', triggering false alarms in production metrics. The fix excludes null payment method entries during data aggregation and adds a regression test to ensure these orders do not affect alarm triggers. The changes improve the accuracy of payment health metrics and enhance overall system reliability.

items.title: Enhance Claude Code System Context Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the canonical system string with an ordered representation of `systemBlocks`, ensuring that Anthropic `cache_control` metadata is preserved during Messages routing. It promotes text-only Claude Code `system` and `developer` entries before validation, while maintaining strict error handling for unknown roles and non-text blocks. Overall, these changes improve the robustness and clarity of system context management.

items.title: Enhance openai CLI with latest API updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the `openai` CLI package with the latest changes from the upstream Docs/OpenAPI. Key improvements include updated command mappings, request schema parity, and corrected endpoint paths, all while maintaining backward compatibility for existing users.

items.title: Align OpenAI MCP Server with Latest Docs Updates in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the OpenAI MCP server with the latest OpenAPI contract from AceDataCloud/Docs. Key changes include updates to provider/model enum coverage, request parameter shapes, and endpoint path mappings to ensure spec/code parity while maintaining backward compatibility. The existing MCP server architecture remains intact, with new support added without removing legacy paths.

items.title: OpenAI CLI Verified for Docs Sync in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The OpenAI CLI has been thoroughly checked against the latest `openapi/openai.json` specification, confirming that no code changes are necessary. All supported endpoints, request fields, option mappings, and model enums have been validated, ensuring alignment with the current documentation. This update maintains the integrity of the CLI without any file modifications.

items.title: Sync suno with Docs OpenAPI and update CLI help text in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the `suno` service is in sync with the latest OpenAPI specifications, addressing a stale default model in the CLI help text. The only change made was updating the `SUNO_DEFAULT_MODEL` from `chirp-v4-5` to `chirp-v5-5`, ensuring accurate documentation without altering any code paths or tool signatures.

items.title: Enhance auto sizing for semantic canvas in Backend 🎨
items.summary: This update documents the continuous-ratio semantic canvas planning for explicit `size=auto`, detailing how the platform prioritizes various standards and conventions. It clarifies support for non-preset ratios and ensures deterministic normalization to a 16-pixel grid. The changes improve the handling of image sizes, retaining fail-open behavior while distinguishing between explicit `auto` and omitted sizes.

items.title: Enhance Auto Size Classification for Images in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new classification system for `size=auto` prompts using `gpt-5.6-luna`, allowing for a continuous aspect ratio instead of fixed sizes. Key improvements include validation against common standards, normalization to provider limits, and async task handling for better performance. The implementation has been tested across multiple services, ensuring consistency and accuracy in image sizing.

items.title: Enhance Cached Token Assertions in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update strengthens the cached-token recorder by ensuring that cached details are populated before both non-stream and streaming price calculations. Additionally, it verifies that the cost object is correctly injected into the response usage. The changes have passed focused usage tests and the full OpenAI worker suite, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Enhance Reasoning Summaries and Model IDs in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update preserves the `reasoning.summary` through canonical routing and emits the complete official reasoning-summary SSE lifecycle. Additionally, it normalizes display-only `[1m]` suffixes from public `/v1/models` IDs while maintaining internal capability discovery. These changes improve the clarity and usability of model IDs and enhance the overall response handling.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Response Billing Accuracy in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the accuracy of billing for OpenAI responses by reading authoritative usage data from the response stream. Key changes include preserving cached token details in JSON and streaming records, along with adding regression tests for both non-streaming and real-shape streaming usage. The adjustments aim to ensure that billing reflects actual usage more accurately, addressing previous discrepancies.

items.title: Enhance Messages Reference Parity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a configurable live differential suite for Anthropic Messages, allowing for comprehensive comparisons of non-stream fields and tool usage. Key changes include aligning synthesized Message objects with nullable fields and ensuring optional reference credentials for CI and forks. The validation process confirmed 83 tests passed with no failures, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Updated Model Mappings for Claude in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new mappings for Claude families to their respective GPT fallback tiers. Key changes include routing `kimi-k3`, `claude-fable-5`, and `claude-opus-5` to `gpt-5.6-sol`, while Opus 4.5-4.8 aliases now point to `gpt-5.5`. The complete mapping is maintained in `modelAliases.js`, ensuring consistency across production environments.

items.title: Update Suno Consumption Rates to 0.56 Credits in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update normalizes the remaining Suno consumption rates from 0.55 to 0.56 credits across various rules, including extend, underpainting, and artist consistency. The API billing and service display pricing have been aligned accordingly, ensuring no 0.55 values remain in the billing files. All related tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the changes.

items.title: Enhance Soft Cutoff for Expired Deployments in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update extends the grace period for expired deployments from 3 to 7 days, allowing workloads to continue running without interruption. It introduces a soft cutoff mechanism that enables immediate unblocking upon payment, eliminating the need to wait for cron jobs. Additionally, the PR includes comprehensive tests to ensure compatibility and proper handling of various states.

items.title: Ensure Suno CLI Sync with Documentation in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the Suno CLI is fully synchronized with the latest documentation updates. All endpoints, actions, models, and request parameters have been confirmed to align with the current OpenAPI contract. Notably, the recent changes in the documentation were purely content updates, requiring no modifications to the CLI or tests.

items.title: Update Suno MCP for OpenAPI Sync in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the Suno MCP server with the latest OpenAPI changes, focusing on API-surface parity within the `suno/` package. Key enhancements include updated request parameter handling, model and enum coverage, and consistent response mapping to match current documentation. Backward compatibility is preserved while integrating new fields for improved functionality.

items.title: Optimize Suno Consumption Rates in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update reduces Suno generation and consumption costs from 0.77 to 0.56 credits, and all stems consumption from 2.2 to 1.6 credits. The changes ensure that API billing and service display pricing remain aligned, while also updating relevant cost assertions. Comprehensive testing has confirmed that all related tests passed successfully.

items.title: Enhanced Security Measures for Account Verification in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical vulnerabilities in account verification processes by refining the detection of fraudulent signups. Key changes include stricter rules for local-part username formats and improved conditions for identifying suspicious account patterns. The modifications aim to enhance the overall security and integrity of the authentication system.

items.title: Enhance Subscription Status Handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update integrates subscription status directly from the backend, ensuring accurate representation of states like 'suspended' and 'reclaimed'. The BillingBar component has been refactored to eliminate hardcoded values and now displays relevant information for all subscription types, improving user experience. Additionally, internationalization has been updated to support new status messages across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance Ingress Traffic Control for Expired Tenants in Backend 🚦
items.summary: This update introduces a soft cutoff capability for Ingress traffic, allowing expired tenants to be redirected without stopping their workloads. Key changes include the implementation of a new method for blocking traffic at the Ingress level while preserving the runtime state of applications. The modifications ensure that expired tenants can renew their services seamlessly, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

items.title: Upgrade Python Setup Action to Version 7 in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the actions/setup-python from version 5 to 7 across the workflow files. Key enhancements include migration to ESM, improved error handling, and updated documentation. These changes will enhance the reliability and performance of Python setup in our CI/CD processes.

items.title: Enhance API Compliance with OpenAI Standards in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns our API response fields with the official OpenAI API by addressing five key discrepancies. Notable fixes include correcting the Responses stream to avoid sending extra `[DONE]` signals and adding missing fields like `instructions` and `service_tier`. A new test suite has been introduced to ensure ongoing compliance and catch any future discrepancies.

items.title: Reprioritize Channels for Better Output Quality in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: The channel order for nano-banana has been updated to prioritize mountsea over cqtai, improving output quality. This change affects both the `/nano-banana` and `/nano-banana/tasks` routes while keeping all policies unchanged. The deployment script has also been corrected to reflect this new order, ensuring consistency across configurations.
